paper.title: DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls into Self-Improving Pipelines
paper.central_claim: 以 signatures/modules 声明多阶段 LM 程序，再由 teleprompter 用任务反馈编译其示例/提示参数，减少手工提示并在数学及多跳问答上提升不同 LM 的系统质量；同时提出更广泛的 foundation-model programming 抽象。
paper.scope_reason: 实际评估的冻结 LM 分支生成、筛选并保留每模块 demonstrations，供之后输入复用，构成离线 harness 编译闭环；不以 finetuning 分支入围。

provenance.notes: 使用既有指定 Sol type；无可绑定的独立实际模型回执/会话收据字段，不探测模型配置。全文静态阅读，无运行或复现。

sections_read: Appendices A–F, all code/prompt examples and tables
materials.notes: 完整阅读绑定 HTML 文本；表格按原列复核，未运行内嵌代码。

evidence.quote: long strings of instructions and demonstrations that are hand crafted through manual trial and error. We argue that this approach, while pervasive, can be brittle and unscalable—conceptually akin to hand-tuning the weights for a classifier. A given string prompt might not generalize to different pipelines or across different LMs, data domains, or even inputs.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者定位手工提示跨流水线/模型脆弱；不是独立开发者实验。
DSPy 明示承接 DSP；不据此推定已核读 DSP 原文。

evidence.support_explanation: 递归定位 Predict，参数包括 instruction/field/demo；本版实做重心为 demonstrations。

evidence.quote:
This teleprompter will simulate a teacher program (or, if unset, the zero-shot version of the program being compiled) on some training inputs, possibly one or more times with a high temperature. When running in
compile
mode, multi-stage traces are tracked transparently and in a thread-safe fashion throughout execution. The program’s metric is used to filter for multi-stage traces that together help the pipeline pass the metric. We thus obtain potential labels for all signatures in the program by throwing away the bad examples and using the good examples as potential demonstrations, though these design decisions are under user control.

evidence.quote: The HotPotQA test set is hidden, so we reserve the official validation set for our testing, and sample 1000 examples for that. We sub-divide the training set into 70%/30% train/validation splits. In the training (and thus validation) split, we keep only examples marked as “hard” in the original dataset, which matches the designation of the official validation and test sets. For training and for reporting development results, we sample 200 and 300 examples respectively.

signatures.object: 每个 Predict 的 demonstration 参数；基本 LM 冻结
signatures.information: 用户程序/signature，少量训练输入，任务 metric，兼容教师（可默认学生自身）；部分任务使用末端答案标签
signatures.operation: 递归映射 predictor→执行教师并记录各节点输入输出→整程序 metric 过滤→将通过轨迹中的局部示例附入相应模块
signatures.output: 有自动 demonstrations 的 compiled_program
signatures.conditions: 程序须能偶尔通过 metric；教师/学生 predictor 可映射；末端通过不蕴含所有中间步骤正确
signatures.feedback: 端到端数值正确率/答案 EM/用户约束
signatures.selection_rule: 只保留通过 metric 的训练轨迹；后续候选搜索另选
signatures.selection_data: 训练集（数学200；HotPot200），不含最终测试
signatures.persistence: 返回拷贝程序各 predictor.demonstrations；不是只保留当前答案
signatures.later_use: 新问题推理时用模块化示例提示；可作为下一次编译的 teacher
signatures.claimed_effect: 无手写中间标签也能获得多阶段条件化示例
signatures.failure_boundary: 弱初始模型无有效轨迹时难启动；信用分配只是整体通过门控；权重更新分支不计入此签名

signatures.object: 各模块示例子集及可选 ensemble
signatures.information: 已过滤候选，train/validation metric，预设调用图
signatures.operation: 随机打乱/选示例编译多个候选→验证打分→保留最大分者或组合 top candidates
signatures.output: 固定 compiled prompt/program 或多数投票 ensemble
signatures.conditions: 选择集代表未来任务；选集与报告集隔离；足够调用预算
signatures.selection_rule: 交叉验证/validation 最优；ensemble 聚合多个已编译候选
signatures.selection_data: GSM8K development300；HotPot train交叉验证；不是 test
signatures.persistence: compiled program 的 demonstrations 与外围 ensemble 结构
signatures.later_use: 固定候选用于官方 GSM test / HotPot 保留样本，不继续用测试标签更新
signatures.claimed_effect: 编译后跨输入提高最终准确率
signatures.failure_boundary: ensemble 增加测试调用；非任意架构自动搜索；验证噪声/搜索过拟合未完整审计

gap.author_gap: 手工字符串提示与特定模型/流水线耦合；单调用 prompt 优化不足以自动配置复合程序的中间示例。
